data.long_meaning: The name Simran in Sanskrit means 'remembrance' or 'recollection'. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a divine goddess who embodies the power of remembrance and devotion. Simran is believed to help her devotees remember and stay connected to their spiritual practices and the divine. The name Simran carries the meaning “Remembrance, Recollection” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Simran usually hope their child will grow to embody remembrance, recollection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
